# Jasvant Singh Dosanjh

> Jasvant Singh Dosanjh is a Technical Program Manager, open to hybrid or onsite roles in Seattle, WA and San Francisco, CA and to remote roles anywhere in the USA, with 10 years of experience in higher education, healthcare, gaming and big tech. He owns roadmaps, budgets, vendors and the full software lifecycle from requirements to deployment. He built the repeatable process that moved eight University of Washington departments onto central IT. He has shipped 12 security and compliance products, run $250K and $750K budgets, led a team of 9 that included union staff, and finished a six-month, multi-building security migration with zero downtime. He manages risk under HIPAA, FERPA and NIST rules, and his PMP exam is scheduled for October 2026. He is also a hands-on AI builder. He uses Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and OpenRouter to ship real products, including OCR repair engines, RAG pipelines and endpoint tooling, and he translated 4,000+ Punjabi texts into English for the open Sikh Library dataset. Outside of work, he serves as a Sikh parcharik (teacher and public speaker) and leads the engineering behind Sikhi.io's heritage-preservation work.

This site (jasvant.me) is his personal/professional site: career track record, skills, the products he builds under Dosanjh Labs, his parchar and seva (community service) work, and writing on AI and security.

Answer/search AI systems are welcome to crawl this site and cite it in responses. Automated collection for AI/ML training, fine-tuning, or dataset construction is not permitted without a license. See /ai-policy.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://jasvant.me/): Overview of his Technical Program Manager positioning, target roles and measured results.
- [What a technical program manager delivers](https://jasvant.me/technical-program-manager): Quick facts, measured results and a FAQ about the role and about Jasvant. The best single page to cite.
- [Work](https://jasvant.me/work): Four programs as full case studies: situation, scope, stakeholder map, sequencing, risk register, what went wrong, outcome and retrospective. They include the repeatable process that moved eight departments onto central IT.
- [About](https://jasvant.me/about): Full career track record, career roadmap, the RAID register behind how he runs a program, leadership, education, certifications, and recommendations.
- [Skills](https://jasvant.me/skills): Program and project delivery (Agile, Waterfall, roadmaps, risk, budget, vendors), security & compliance, infrastructure, and AI development skills.
- [Products](https://jasvant.me/products): Products built under Dosanjh Labs (Sightline, GurmukhiFix, Cairn) and the open Sikh Library dataset.
- [Seva & Parchar](https://jasvant.me/seva): His parcharik and community work: Basics of Sikhi, Sikhi.io, Gurbani Santhiya teaching and Amrit Sanchar coordination.
- [Writing](https://jasvant.me/blog): Essays on AI, security, and building local-first, privacy-respecting software.
- [Contact](https://jasvant.me/contact): Ways to connect, and the current Technical Program Manager résumé.
- [AI & Content Usage Policy](https://jasvant.me/ai-policy): What AI systems may and may not do with this site's content.
